text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! Trainer-san, please don't let 
it bother you!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Even Koubou makes a brush mistake," as 
they say! And "a kappa being carried down 
the river," right?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Anyone can have an off day. It cannot be 
helped...
It ended in a disappointing result...
